stories.title: Fiona the hippo dies days after swallowing hat, Cincinnati Zoo says
stories.summary: Fiona the hippo, who survived being born prematurely and rose to global fame, has died, the Cincinnati Zoo & Botanical Garden announced Thursday.

stories.title: University of Michigan Board of Regents approves controversial research computing and data center
stories.summary: After months of outcry from community members and even elected officials in Ypsilanti Township, the University of Michigan Board of Regents voted 7-1 on Thursday to proceed with building a research computing center in collaboration with Los Alamos National Laboratory.

stories.title: Metro Detroiters participate in Covenant House's "Sleep Out"
stories.summary: Hundreds of people across the Metro Detroit area are giving up their beds for the night, sleeping outside to help fight youth homelessness.

stories.title: Ypsilanti Twp. residents to keep fighting approved research center
stories.summary: After months of outcry from community members and even elected officials in Ypsilanti Township, the University of Michigan Board of Regents voted 7-1 on Thursday to still proceed with building a research computing center in collaboration with Los Alamos National Laboratory.

stories.title: U.S. Army delays planned detonation of unstable explosives in Iowa that could send toxic dust into Illinois
stories.summary: The U.S. Army has delayed plans to detonate unstable explosives at a munition plant in Iowa, amid concerns about the risks of a plume of dust containing toxic lead particles that could spread across parts of Iowa and Illinois.

stories.title: Detroit Fire Department official not disciplined after misusing credentials at venue, OIG report concludes
stories.summary: The OIG recommended "appropriate disciplinary action" and that all fire marshal division personnel undergo ethics and badge-use training.

stories.title: Woman scammed out of more than $1,700 for miniature goats, Troy police say
stories.summary: Police say the woman reported being threatened to pay additional fees and avoid animal abandonment charges.

stories.title: Several McDonald's locations in Metro Detroit helping families in need
stories.summary: Twelve McDonald's locations are getting into the holiday spirit by giving out free turkeys on Thursday.

stories.title: Royal Oak Market Art Fair kicks off Thursday
stories.summary: The 11th annual Art Fair in Royal Oak is underway on Thursday and Friday.

stories.title: Batman's Batpod among $13.2 million in movie props up for auction
stories.summary: Batman's Batpod is among $13.2 million in movie props up for auction in December at Propstore's Winter Entertainment Memorabilia Live Auction.

stories.title: Commerce Township teacher saves choking student: "It was my job to help her"
stories.summary: An elementary school student in Commerce Township, Michigan, is safe after the heroic actions of her teacher saved her life.

stories.title: Consumers stock their doomsday pantries as tech outages cause jitters
stories.summary: Companies such as Costco and Walmart are seeing a surge in sales for generators, canned goods and other disaster-preparedness staples.
